entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. For questions about an existing order, press 1. For returns or exchanges, press 2.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David... I, um, I need to return something. It's a jersey I bought a little while ago.
I can certainly help you with that. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Sarah Miller. Order number is VF78901.
Thank you, Sarah. I'm pulling that up now... I see the ClubFit Jersey. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference with the fit?
It's just the fit. I ordered my usual size, but it was the wrong size for me. It's just... way too tight. I'm so disappointed, I saved up for this and was really looking forward to it.
I'm sorry to hear it wasn't the right fit for you. I see the order was delivered about 50 days ago. Let me just check our policy for you.
Oh, 50 days? I hope that's okay. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years and I really need this money back. I was going to ask for an exchange, but things are a bit tight right now.

I completely understand, Sarah. And thank you for being a long-time customer. Let me see... yes, good news. The ClubFit jersey falls under our standard 90-day return policy. You are well within the window to return it for a full refund.
Really? Oh, thank goodness! That is such a relief. I was so worried I had waited too long. Thank you, David!

You're very welcome. I've just initiated the return process for you. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email we have on file. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the item, you'll see the refund in 3-5 business days.
That's perfect. You've been a huge help. Thank you so much for making this easy.
It's my pleasure, Sarah. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
